defect.summary: the single be_r5_publish_target call site is placed in a bounded loop whose trip count is 2

entries.notes: A static volatile int trip counter initialised to 2 guards a while loop around the existing call, so neither GCC nor Clang can prove the trip count at -O2 or unroll it into two references. check-fixtures.mjs asserts exactly one <be_r5_publish_target> reference in the built image, so an optimiser change is reported rather than silently turned into a different fixture.

defect.summary: be_r5_switch_tail arms hvip[2] then hie[2] with csrsi, after every entry-control readback and the last frame restore, immediately before .option pop and the jump to be_r5_enter_guest_tail

entries.notes: Plan revision R6-A. The only dynamic fixture that enters the guest, preempted at 0x40011000 before any protected instruction retires, so the trace holds the two management VS entries only. Asserts scause=0x8000000000000002; a different observed cause is wrong-error-class and requires a plan revision, not a run-time relaxation. It cannot live in r5-runtime.c: the accepted be_r5_switch_tail re-reads hie and hvip and rejects a non-zero value before SRET, so any arming inside switch_domain terminates as entry-controls. The two csrsi instructions take a 5-bit immediate, read and write no GPR, add no call, no HGATP write, and no fence, and sit after the pinned readback order and after the eighth frame restore pair, so the accepted image checker still passes unchanged. Plan revision R6-B pins the resulting image exactly: ten differing flat-image bytes in two runs per toolchain, an unchanged .monitor.text allocated size, and unchanged addresses for every symbol L8 fixes or requires, with be_r5_switch_tail's symbol-table size the only permitted recorded difference. Non-allocated debug and symbol-table content is out of scope for L8 by construction and is never pinned.
